name: Caveman SpongeBob
look: A blurry SpongeBob SquarePants frame of SpongeBob as a primitive caveman in a brown loincloth. He hunches with arms spread and fingers curled, heavy brows furrowed and big lips hanging open with his tongue out, while a pink figure stands behind him in the dark.
use: Shows a primitive, brainless or instinct-driven reaction. The caption describes someone reduced to caveman behavior, like spotting free food, hearing a strange noise or facing technology they don't understand.
examples: Me seeing free pizza in the break room
Me after an hour of trying to fix the printer
describe: spongebob as a caveman with big lips and tongue out
hunched prehistoric spongebob in a loincloth
spongebob with bushy eyebrows looking dumb and primal
old blurry spongebob in a monkey pose with arms out
origin: A frame of SpongeBob as a hunched caveman from a prehistoric-themed SpongeBob SquarePants episode.
